answer: In a market forecasting lotus and walnut crop prices, each forecast targets the same weekly price pulse. Settlement uses one fixed reward pool per event and groups byte-identical forecasts by content hash; members split the group's score-based share, regardless of how many accounts submitted it. An attacker can submit varied guesses, but each needs a nonrefundable fee and a locked bond, and bad forecasts lose money under a proper scoring rule. Honest agents may independently agree, so grouping uses only exact matches; near-duplicates remain a weakness that fees cannot eliminate.
